record.content: The USGS Geographic Names service identifies Lower Lamarck Lake as feature 263027 at 37.217194631601274, -118.64269546315641; Upper Lamarck Lake as feature 268621 at 37.210308065833495, -118.65094909325705; and the Bishop Creek Treasure Lakes as feature 268392 at 37.142536635570956, -118.57273519703854. A second California Treasure Lakes feature exists elsewhere, so the Inyo County coordinate and official South Lake map context are retained to disambiguate this destination.
